|translation='''Title:''' Captain Khurgee.

'''Card text:'''
During your control phase, you may use 2 Force to search your Reserve Deck for one Scanning Crew and take it into hand. Then shuffle the deck, cut, and replace.

'''Lore:'''
A docking-bay security officer and leader. Known as a brave man who went aboard the Star Destroyer Thunderflare and rescued five officers from a shuttle crash.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Printed title is カーギー大尉. Scanning Crew is 「探査部隊」.
